title: Contract Pack
description: Phase 4.7 — a versioned contract draft generated from the talent's contract template (Phase 1 onboarding) + the deal's confirmed proposal commercials (Phase 4.6) + agent-uploaded brand legal info. 7-stage pipeline: context augmentation → merge field extraction → conditional clause evaluation → narrative drafting → composition → HARD LEGAL REVIEW GATE → render. Output: markdown source (canonical) + Word .docx (editable) + PDF (read-only). Existing `deal.contract.draft_contract_attachment_id` and `contract_attachment_id` auto-populate from the latest contract pack render. Stored at `data/deals/{deal_id}/contract_packs/v{N}.json` (gitignored). See `docs/contract_pack_workflow.md`.

contract_pack_id.description: Globally unique identifier. Format: `cp_{deal_id_short}_v{N}`. The `cp_` prefix distinguishes from prep packs (`prep_*`) and proposal packs (`pp_*`).

deal_id.description: FK to the Phase 4 deal. The deal's `contract.contract_pack_ids[]` array references all versions; `contract.latest_contract_pack_id` points to the current `is_latest: true` version.

trigger.description: agent_initiated_v1: first draft. agent_*regenerate: NL-feedback regen of various scopes. brand_redline_response: agent uploaded brand's redlined version + triggered regen targeting the redlined sections. amendment_request: post-execution amendment (writes to `deal.contract.amendment_log[]` instead of replacing the executed contract).

pre_generation_guidance.description: Free-text guidance from the agent before generation. e.g. 'Brand mentioned in call they have strict NDAs — make sure confidentiality clause is comprehensive.'

regeneration_feedback.description: NL feedback on parent_version. Populated when version > 1.

target_sections.description: For section/per-clause regen: which sections were rebuilt. e.g. ['merge_field_values', 'conditional_clause_decisions.gdpr', 'narrative_sections.scope_of_work'].

amendment_log_entry_ref.description: If trigger=amendment_request: ISO-timestamp matching the `deal.contract.amendment_log[].at` entry this version documents. Closes the bidirectional link with `amendment_log[].contract_pack_version` (parallel to negotiation_log_entry_ref on proposal_pack).

context_snapshot.description: Frozen upstream context this version was generated from. If the talent template or deal data evolves, this version stays anchored.

template_version_used.description: Value of `talent.contract_template.template_version` at generation time. Anchors this pack to the template version it used — template updates don't retroactively change historic packs.

talent_billing_entity_snapshot.description: Frozen snapshot of `talent.billing_entity` at generation time. Legal-name changes don't break old contracts.

proposal_pack_id_at_gen.description: Which proposal pack version provided the canonical commercial values consumed.

discovery_debrief_snapshot.description: Frozen copy of `deal.lead.discovery_debrief` at generation time. Informs conditional clause evaluation.

brand_legal_entity_at_gen.description: Brand's legal entity info as known at generation time. Often provided via context_artefacts (agent-uploaded W-9 / company registration / etc.).

signatory_name.description: Person signing on behalf of the brand. Often different from primary_contact.

comparable_contracts_referenced.description: FKs to context_artefacts of prior contracts with this brand (or similar brands). Helps the LLM mirror prior conventions where appropriate.

context_artefacts.description: Files uploaded by the agent in Stage A — brand legal info, brand-requested clauses, prior contracts. Same shape as `proposal_pack.context_artefacts` (parser metadata, parsed_text, llm_summary, relevance_tag).

merge_field_values.description: Every merge field declared in `talent.contract_template.merge_field_definitions[]`, with extracted/agent-supplied value + provenance + confidence. Stage B output. Critical fields (legal names, fees, dates) with low confidence or missing values block the legal review gate.

value.description: Extracted/computed/agent-supplied value. Type varies — string, number, date.

source.description: Which source the value came from. `default` = fell back to merge_field_definitions[].default. `agent_input` = agent provided directly (typically brand legal info).

confidence.description: high: deterministic extraction (e.g. fee_usd from deal.proposal). medium: LLM-inferred with strong signal. low: LLM guess. missing: no value found, needs_review flag set.

needs_review.description: If true, blocks legal review gate until agent reviews + confirms. Auto-set for low/missing confidence on required fields.

agent_overridden.description: True if agent edited LLM-extracted value.

conditional_clause_decisions.description: Per-conditional-block decision from Stage C. Each entry covers one `{{#if clause_id}}...{{/if}}` block in the template.

decided_by.description: How the decision was reached. template_default: rule had default_decision=include/exclude. llm: rule had llm_decide and Stage C evaluated. agent: agent overrode the LLM decision.

applicability_rationale.description: LLM's explanation for the decision. Cites which context signals drove inclusion/exclusion.

narrative_sections.description: LLM-drafted content for each `{{narrative_*}}` placeholder declared in `talent.contract_template.narrative_placeholders[]`. Stage D output.

sources.description: Which context paths the LLM drew from (e.g. 'deal.proposal.deliverables[0..2]', 'discovery_debrief.objectives_heard[1]').

composed_markdown.description: The final composed contract — template markdown_source with all merge fields substituted, conditional blocks resolved (included blocks kept verbatim, excluded blocks stripped), narrative placeholders filled. Stage E output. This is the canonical source-of-truth that the Word and PDF artefacts render from. Agent direct edits update this string + log to agent_edits[]; subsequent renders regenerate Word + PDF from the updated source.

legal_review.description: The HARD LEGAL REVIEW GATE. Word + PDF artefacts cannot render until approved_at is set. Any edit post-approval resets the gate (re-approval required) unless trivial_edit_override is true.

required.description: v0.1: always true. v0.2 if agency-configurable gate is added, agencies can opt out.

reviewer_id.description: Defaulted from talent.contract_template.legal_reviewer_id (if set) or deal.assigned_agent_id. Only this identity can approve.

blocking_issues.description: Automatically populated: merge_field_values entries where needs_review=true OR required field is missing/low-confidence; clause_decisions agent has flagged for re-evaluation; narrative sections agent has flagged. Gate cannot pass with non-empty blocking_issues.

approved_at.description: When the reviewer passed the gate. ABSENT = Word + PDF artefacts blocked. Setting this enables Stage G render.

approval_notes.description: Optional notes captured at approval (e.g. 'reviewed by external counsel; minor wording change on indemnification — see edit log').

previous_approvals.description: If edits reset the gate, prior approvals are pushed here as an audit trail. Each entry is the prior {approved_at, approved_by_agent_id, approval_notes} + the timestamp the approval was reset + reset_reason.

reset_reason.description: What edit triggered the reset (e.g. 'agent edited merge_field fee_usd', 'narrative scope_of_work regenerated').

agent_edits.description: Append-only audit log of direct edits (no LLM regen). Edits that change merge field values / clause decisions / narrative content / composed markdown reset the legal review gate (push current approval to previous_approvals[]).

resets_legal_gate.description: Most edits reset the gate. Trivial edits (whitespace, typo) can be flagged to NOT reset — agent decides at edit time.

trivial_edit_override.description: If true, edit does NOT reset legal_review.approved_at. Agent must explicitly mark trivial.

contextArtefact.description: Same shape as proposal_pack.context_artefact, with contract-specific type enum values.

type.description: brand_legal_info: W-9, company registration, corporate structure documents. brand_requested_clauses: specific clauses the brand has asked be included. prior_contract: previous executed contract with this brand (for convention matching). brand_redline / talent_redline: redlined versions received during review.

llm_extracted_signals.description: Optional structured extraction (e.g. brand_legal_info → legal_name, registered_address, tax_id, signatory).
